fasten one's seat belt: Please fasten your seat belt so that it clicks shut before the plane takes off.
飛機起飛前，請繫好安全帶，直到它「喀」一聲扣緊。
fasten one's eyes on: During the whole performance, the little boy would fasten his eyes on the dancers and never look away.
整場表演中，小男孩都目不轉睛盯著舞者，從未移開視線。
fasten the blame on: The manager tried to fasten the blame on his assistant, although the mistake was clearly his own.
經理想把責任歸於他的助理，雖然那個錯誤顯然是他自己犯的。
favor the proposal: Most members of the student council favor the proposal and plan to vote yes at Friday's meeting.
學生會大部分成員都支持這項提案，並打算在週五的會議上投贊成票。
favor one child over another: Good parents try not to favor one child over another, because it can make the other kids feel hurt.
好的父母會盡量不偏心，因為這可能讓其他孩子感到受傷。
the odds favor us: We have the best players and we are playing at home, so the odds favor us in tonight's game.
我們有最好的球員，又是主場比賽，所以今晚的比賽勝算在我們。
favor someone with a smile: The shy girl finally looked up and decided to favor him with a smile when he said hello.
當他打招呼時，那個害羞的女孩終於抬起頭，決定賜予他一個微笑。
in favor of: After a long discussion, most students voted in favor of wearing casual clothes on Fridays.
經過長時間討論，大多數學生投票贊成星期五穿便服。
feast on seafood: When we visit the fishing village, we always feast on seafood like fresh shrimp, crabs, and oysters.
我們去漁村時，總是大啖海鮮，例如新鮮的蝦子、螃蟹和牡蠣。
feast one's eyes on: Visitors to the garden in spring can feast their eyes on thousands of colorful tulips.
春天到花園參觀的遊客可以大飽眼福，欣賞成千上萬朵五顏六色的鬱金香。
a feast for the senses: The night market is a feast for the senses, with bright lights, loud music, and the smell of delicious food.
夜市是一場感官饗宴，有明亮的燈光、大聲的音樂和美食的香味。
feature a famous actor: The new action movie will feature a famous actor from Hong Kong as the main character.
這部新動作片將由一位來自香港的名演員主演。
feature in the news: After she saved the drowning child, the brave student began to feature in the news all over the country.
那位勇敢的學生救了溺水的孩子之後，開始登上全國各地的新聞。
the exhibit features: The exhibit features more than two hundred paintings by artists from all over Asia.
這個展覽展出超過兩百幅來自亞洲各地藝術家的畫作。
feature prominently: Tea culture continues to feature prominently in the history and daily life of Taiwan.
茶文化在臺灣的歷史和日常生活中持續占有重要地位。
feed one's curiosity: Visiting science museums is a great way to feed your curiosity about how the world works.
參觀科學博物館是滿足你對世界如何運作的好奇心的好方法。
feed on fear: Panic tends to feed on fear: the more scared people become, the faster it grows.
恐慌往往靠恐懼滋長：人們越害怕，它就增長得越快。
feed information: The spy continued to feed information to the enemy for years before he was finally caught.
那名間諜持續向敵方提供資訊多年，最後才被抓到。
feed the fire: Posting angry comments online will only feed the fire and make the argument even worse.
在網路上發表憤怒的留言只會火上加油，讓爭吵變得更糟。
feed a family: With prices rising so quickly, it is getting harder to feed a family of five on one small salary.
物價上漲得這麼快，靠一份微薄的薪水養活五口之家越來越困難了。
fence off the area: After the gas leak, the police decided to fence off the area and keep everyone away.
瓦斯外洩後，警方決定把該區域圍起來，讓所有人遠離。
sit on the fence: You can't sit on the fence forever; at some point you have to choose which plan you support.
你不能永遠騎牆觀望；總有一天你得選擇你支持哪個計畫。
fence with someone: The two candidates liked to fence with each other on TV, trading clever words as if they were swords.
兩位候選人喜歡在電視上與彼此唇槍舌戰，你來我往的機智話語就像刀劍一樣。
fetch a high price: Old comic books in perfect condition can fetch a high price at auctions these days.
保存完好的舊漫畫書如今在拍賣會上可以賣得高價。
fetch water: In some villages, children must walk two kilometers every morning to fetch water from the well and carry it home.
在一些村莊裡，孩子們每天早上必須走兩公里去井邊打水，再把水提回家。
fetch the doctor: When Grandma suddenly fell ill in the middle of the night, my father rushed out to fetch the doctor.
奶奶半夜突然生病時，我爸爸衝出去請醫生。
figure out the answer: It took me almost an hour to figure out the answer to the last math problem on the test.
我花了將近一個小時才想出考卷上最後一題數學的答案。
figure in the plan: Safety must figure in the plan for the school trip, so we will bring a nurse with us.
安全必須在校外教學的計畫中占一席之地，所以我們會帶一位護理師同行。
it figures: "Jack skipped practice all week and then lost the match." "Well, it figures; you can't win without training."
「傑克整個星期都沒練習，結果比賽輸了。」「果然，不訓練是不可能贏的。」
figure prominently: Family values figure prominently in many traditional Chinese stories that children read at school.
家庭價值觀在許多孩子在學校讀的中國傳統故事中占重要地位。
